tools.name: ue_editor_status
tools.title: Get Unreal Editor Status
tools.description: Return editor status: engine version, current level, selection, viewport camera, capabilities and active policy. Read-only. First entry point for any client.

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_actor_query
tools.title: Query Unreal Actors
tools.description: Query actors in the current editor level or selection. Read-only. Supports class/name/label/tag/folder/component filters, field selection, sorting and pagination.

class.description: 类名或类路径，匹配派生类

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_actor_edit
tools.title: Edit Unreal Actors
tools.description: Batch edit actors: spawn, delete, set_transform, set_properties (whitelist only), duplicate, select. Runs in an editor transaction (atomic by default). delete requires confirmation (elicitation or --allow-destructive); dryRun requires none. Rejected while PIE is running.

atomic.description: 失败时通过事务取消回滚

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_level_control
tools.title: Control Level
tools.description: Query current level and dirty packages; open, save, create levels. open discards unsaved changes only with allowDiscardUnsaved+confirm; save_all requires confirmation (elicitation or --allow-destructive).

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_asset_search
tools.title: Search Unreal Assets
tools.description: Search assets by path/name/class via AssetRegistry; optional dependency and referencer queries (BFS depth <= 3). Read-only, paginated.

query.description: 匹配资产名或包路径，不区分大小写

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_material_params
tools.title: Material Parameters
tools.description: List/get material or material-instance parameters; set parameters on MaterialInstanceConstant only (base materials rejected with NOT_AN_INSTANCE); create material instances.

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_viewport_capture
tools.title: Capture Viewport Screenshot
tools.description: Capture the level viewport or PIE as PNG/JPEG. activateWindow=true brings the editor window to the foreground first (mitigates UE throttling when unfocused; Windows only, returns an activation block) and defaults to false. returnMode=image inlines base64 (<= 8 MiB, read from the captured file on this machine) otherwise falls back to file path with a warning. Screenshots are written to <Project>/Saved/UEMCP/captures/ and audited.

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_blueprint
tools.title: Blueprint Query / Compile
tools.description: Read blueprint structure (parent class, variables, components, graphs, interfaces, compile state; node read is experimental) and trigger compilation. Node creation/wiring is not supported (CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE in P2).

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_pie_control
tools.title: PIE Control
tools.description: Start / stop / restart Play-In-Editor (PIE) or query its status. start/stop/restart are write actions (server policy != read-only AND bridge allowWrite); status is always allowed. waitReadyMs bounds how long the bridge waits for PIE readiness (0..120000, default 15000); the server-side bridge timeout for this tool is 60s.

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_policy_explain
tools.title: Explain Policy & Tool Visibility
tools.description: Explain the current server policy: per-tool visibility, the gate controlling it (server.policy / server.allowConsole / server.allowExec), narrowed actions under read-only, and the bridge connection state from the watchdog health cache. Purely informational: no RPC, no side effects, always visible.

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_reflect
tools.title: Reflect Object Functions
tools.description: List the functions exposed by an object (BlueprintCallable UFUNCTIONs mapped to Python attributes) plus their parameter counts. target may be an asset/actor path ('/Game/...:MyActor') or a class name (first matching instance is used). Read-only.

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_call_function
tools.title: Call Object Function
tools.description: Call a BlueprintCallable function by name on an object or actor (target may be a path or a class name; function names are matched case-insensitively via snake_case). Arguments are passed positionally as JSON. Returns the function's return value, or returnedVoid=true when the function returns nothing. Write action: requires policy standard or higher AND bridge allowWrite.

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure

tools.name: ue_log_query
tools.title: Query Editor Log
tools.description: Search the current project's editor log (Saved/Logs/<Project>.log) with an optional regex pattern, level filter (Error/Warning/Log/Display), since timestamp and pagination. Returns matched lines with line numbers. Read-only; restricted to the project's log directory.

outputSchema.description: UEMCP envelope (§5.0.1): success = { ok:true, data, warnings, meta }, failure = { ok:false, error, meta }; validated for both isError values.

ok.description: true on success, false on tool failure
